note: Sanitized derivatives of real historical CineBraid project data. Generated by scripts/build-overfit-golden-fixtures.js; do not hand-edit. Source paths are relative to the archive root the build was pointed at and deliberately carry no host-specific prefix.

sanitizationRules.name: identity vocabulary is inviolable
sanitizationRules.summary: Every id, prefix, codes[] token and structural cross-reference is preserved verbatim, in the document and inside any prose that mentions it.

sanitizationRules.name: verbatim by default
sanitizationRules.summary: A string is replaced only when it holds whitespace and its key is named on PROSE_KEYS. Unknown fields pass through untouched so M070 still has something to preserve.

sanitizationRules.name: prose pseudonymization
sanitizationRules.summary: Content words become exact-length syllabic nonsense through a pure function of the lowercased word. Punctuation, digits, stopwords, dependency keywords and identifiers survive.

sanitizationRules.name: filenames are preserved
sanitizationRules.summary: The project_shot_role_version convention M030 reads is left intact, including the shot identifiers embedded in it.

sanitizationRules.name: opaque provider token replacement
sanitizationRules.summary: Provider-minted content-addressed filenames are replaced by same-length deterministic tokens of the same alphabet class, so the shape survives and the provider's identifier does not.

sanitizationRules.name: structure is never touched
sanitizationRules.summary: No key is added, removed or reordered; no array is reordered or resized; absent, null, empty-string, empty-array and empty-object are each left as they were.
